moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: “As crazy as this sounds, $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is no longer impossible.”
moments.why: A wild revenue projection from a high-profile CEO that’s reshaping expectations around space and AI.

moments.author: Robert Saleh
moments.quote: He was released after pulling a gun in the parking lot, but it was more of a cry for help than a criminal act.
moments.why: Titans coach publicly contextualizes a player's gun incident, sparking wide NFL and mental‑health discussions.

moments.author: LeBron James
moments.quote: “Ain’t nothing soft in the Midwest … I’m from Ohio, baby.”
moments.why: LeBron’s fiery courtside clap‑back at a fan stokes heated memes and NBA chatter.

moments.author: Bleacher Report
moments.quote: Kristaps Porzingis is seriously contemplating his future in basketball due to an autoimmune condition; Warriors exploring trade options.
moments.why: An injury‑plagued star debating retirement sends shockwaves through NBA and trade rumor mill.
